Start a New Game

Each map is the smallest that keeps every king at least 3 empty provinces apart. Smaller games can pick a larger map for more room.
Times are read from this computer's clock (local time). Players see the deadline in their own local time. Realms that have not submitted by the deadline hold (Defend) for the turn.
Automatic modes only fire while a GM Portal tab is open and signed in — it watches your games and runs turns for you. Keep a tab open (a pinned tab on any always-on device will do). You can change the mode later from the game screen.
Tick the players who may see and join this private game:
Once you create the game, invited players (Private) or everyone (Public) can see it and sign up. You run Turn 0 once all players have joined to generate their starting turn reports (bot realms are generated at Turn 0).
